name: Poison Enhancement (Ex)
body:
Benefit(s): Whenever a rogue with this talent uses a poisoned weapon to attempt an attack, she adds that weapon’s enhancement bonus (if any) to her poison’s saving throw DC for the poison’s initial delivery, but not on subsequent saving throws made to cure the poison.
